takes.sourceDescription: walk backwards then attack with a punch
takes.title: Step Backward and Finish with a Forward Arm Gesture
takes.actionDescription: The performer takes backward steps with bent arms, then leans and extends an arm before bringing it back in.

takes.sourceDescription: walk backwards, feign a few attacks, then attack
takes.title: Step Backward with Repeated Arm Feints
takes.actionDescription: The performer retreats through several short steps, alternates small arm motions, and ends turned slightly away with the knees bent.

takes.title: Recoil and Step Away with Hands Raised
takes.actionDescription: The performer raises both hands beside the head and steps through several sharp leans and changes of direction, finishing in a bent-knee stance.

takes.title: Raise the Hands and Lower into a Guard Pose
takes.actionDescription: The performer brings both hands near the face and sinks progressively into a low stance, holding the guard through the finish.

takes.title: Mime Swatting a Bug with Low Reaches
takes.actionDescription: The performer darts an arm outward several times, leans forward into short reaches, and straightens while stepping.

takes.title: Lift the Knees to Avoid Stepping on Something
takes.actionDescription: The performer raises a knee sharply and moves sideways with arms open, then lowers the torso and resumes ordinary steps.

takes.title: Hold a Brief Raised-Arm Stance
takes.actionDescription: The performer holds a staggered, slightly turned stance with both forearms raised. The clip lasts about a sixth of a second.

takes.title: Step Carefully over Obstacles
takes.actionDescription: The performer takes measured steps with occasional higher foot lifts and wider arm positions, then settles into a narrow side-facing stance.

takes.title: Walk Backward and Change Facing
takes.actionDescription: The performer takes short backward steps with low arms, turns through profile, and continues stepping with both elbows loosely bent.

takes.title: Turn through Several Angles with Small Steps
takes.actionDescription: The performer takes short steps to change heading, briefly lifts a hand near the chest, and finishes upright in profile.

takes.title: Take Quick Backward Steps
takes.actionDescription: The performer shifts into a series of quick backward steps with the elbows bent, then narrows the stance and slows near the end.
